example.translationZh: 她让那个爱管闲事的邻居别多管闲事，不要再打听她的工资。

definitionEn: n. a sculpture of the head and shoulders of a person\nn. an occasion for excessive eating or drinking
definitionZh:
n. 半身像, 胸部, 失败, 殴打
vt. 使爆裂, 使破产
vi. 爆裂, 破产
[计] 操作错

example.text: The music started, and everyone began to bust a move on the dance floor.
example.translationZh: 音乐响起，大家开始在舞池里跳起舞来。

definitionEn: n. a rapid active commotion\nn. a framework worn at the back below the waist for giving fullness to a woman's skirt\nv. move or cause to move energetically or busily
definitionZh: n. 喧闹, 裙撑\nvi. 奔忙, 喧闹\nvt. 使忙碌, 催促

example.text: The market began to bustle with activity as soon as the sun rose.
example.translationZh: 太阳一升起，市场就开始熙熙攘攘地热闹起来。

definitionEn:
n. a retailer of meat
n. a brutal indiscriminate murderer
n. a person who slaughters or dresses meat for market
v. kill (animals) usually for food consumption
definitionZh: n. 屠夫, 肉商, 小贩\nvt. 屠宰, 屠杀

example.text: I stopped at the butcher's to buy a pound of minced beef for dinner.
example.translationZh: 我在肉店停下来买了一磅碎牛肉做晚饭。

definitionEn:
n. diurnal insect typically having a slender body with knobbed antennae and broad colorful wings
n. a swimming stroke in which the arms are thrown forward together out of the water while the feet kick up and down
v. flutter like a butterfly
v. cut and spread open, as in preparation for cooking
definitionZh: n. 蝴蝶\n[医] 蝶式棉块, 翼形皮癣, 纸蝶

example.text: A single butterfly flapping its wings can set off a chain of events that leads to a storm.
example.translationZh: 一只蝴蝶扇动翅膀可能会引发一系列事件，最终导致一场风暴。

definitionEn:
n. sound of rapid vibration
n. a confusion of activity and gossip
v. make a buzzing sound
v. fly low
definitionZh: n. 嗡嗡声, 流言\nvi. 发出嗡嗡声, 说闲话\nvt. 使嗡嗡叫, 散布

example.text: The classroom was buzzing with excitement before the school trip.
example.translationZh: 学校旅行前，教室里洋溢着兴奋的气氛。

phrase.translationZh: 充满兴奋地嗡嗡作响；洋溢着兴奋

definitionEn: n. a surgically created shunt (usually around a damaged part)\nv. avoid something unpleasant or laborious
definitionZh: n. 旁路\nvt. 省略, 绕过, 忽视, 回避

example.text: The doctor recommended a bypass to improve blood flow to his heart.
example.translationZh: 医生建议进行搭桥手术以改善心脏的血液流动。

definitionEn: n. a compartment at the front of a motor vehicle or locomotive where driver sits\nn. small two-wheeled horse-drawn carriage; with two seats and a folding hood\nn. a car driven by a person whose job is to take passengers where they want to go in exchange for money
definitionZh: n. 出租车, 出租汽车, 出租马车\nvi. 乘出租马车(或汽车)

example.text: It was raining, so we took a cab to the airport.
example.translationZh: 当时正在下雨，所以我们乘出租车去了机场。

definitionEn:
n. small room on a ship or boat where people sleep
n. a small house built of wood; usually in a wooded area
n. the enclosed compartment of an aircraft or spacecraft where passengers are carried
v. confine to a small space, such as a cabin
definitionZh: n. 小屋, 客舱\nvt. 关在小屋

example.text: The cabin crew helped the passengers fasten their seat belts before takeoff.
example.translationZh: 起飞前，机组乘务员帮助乘客系好安全带。

definitionEn:
n. a piece of furniture resembling a cupboard with doors and shelves and drawers; for storage or display
n. persons appointed by a head of state to head executive departments of government and act as official advisers
n. a storage compartment for clothes and valuables; usually it has a lock
n. housing for electronic instruments, as radio or television
definitionZh: n. 橱柜, 内阁\na. 内阁的, 细木工做的\n[计] 机柜

example.text: She keeps the spices in the kitchen cabinet next to the stove.
example.translationZh: 她把香料放在炉灶旁边的厨房橱柜里。

definitionEn:
n. a telegram sent abroad
n. a conductor for transmitting electrical or optical signals or electric power
n. a very strong thick rope made of twisted hemp or steel wire
n. a nautical unit of depth
definitionZh:
n. 电缆, 海底电报, 缆, 索
vi. 打海底电报
vt. 发海底电报, 缚住
[计] 电缆

example.text: Engineers will lay a new cable under the river next month.
example.translationZh: 工程师们下个月将在河底铺设一条新电缆。

definitionEn: n. a small restaurant where drinks and snacks are sold
definitionZh: n. 咖啡馆, 酒店

example.text: We sat at a small table outside the cafe and watched people walk by.
example.translationZh: 我们坐在咖啡馆外的一张小桌旁，看着行人走过。

definitionEn: n. a restaurant where you serve yourself and pay a cashier
definitionZh: n. 自助餐厅\n[经] 自助餐厅

example.text: Students usually eat lunch in the school cafeteria.
example.translationZh: 学生们通常在学校食堂吃午饭。

definitionEn:
n an enclosure made or wire or metal bars in which birds or animals can be kept
n something that restricts freedom as a cage restricts movement
n United States composer of avant-garde music (1912-1992)
n the net that is the goal in ice hockey
n a movable screen placed behind home base to catch balls during batting practice
v confine in a cage
definitionZh: n. 笼子( cage的名词复数 )

example.text: The zoo keeps its parrots in large cages near the entrance.
example.translationZh: 动物园把鹦鹉养在入口附近的大笼子里。

definitionEn: n. an event resulting in great loss and misfortune
definitionZh: n. 灾难, 不幸事件

example.text: The earthquake was the worst calamity to hit the region in a century.
example.translationZh: 这次地震是该地区一个世纪以来遭受的最严重的灾难。

definitionEn: n. a white metallic element that burns with a brilliant light; the fifth most abundant element in the earth's crust; an important component of most plants and animals
definitionZh: n. 钙\n[化] 钙Ca

example.text: The doctor advised her to take a calcium supplement to keep her bones strong.
example.translationZh: 医生建议她服用钙补充剂以保持骨骼强健。

definitionEn:
n. a system of timekeeping that defines the beginning and length and divisions of the year
n. a list or register of events (appointments or social events or court cases etc)
n. a tabular array of the days (usually for one year)
v. enter into a calendar
definitionZh: n. 日历, 日程表\nvt. 列入表中\n[计] 日历

example.text: I marked our anniversary on the calendar so I wouldn't forget it.
example.translationZh: 我在日历上标记了我们的纪念日，以免忘记。

definitionEn:
n. a telephone connection
n. a special disposition (as if from a divine source) to pursue a particular course
n. a demand especially in the phrase "the call of duty"
n. a brief social visit
definitionZh:
n. 呼叫, 访问, 打电话, 号召, 召集, 要求
vt. 呼叫, 召集, 打电话
vi. 叫喊, 访问, 叫牌
[计] 调用; 呼叫; DOS内部命令:在批处理文件中调用另一个批处理文件

example.text: I missed your call this morning, so I will call you back after lunch.
example.translationZh: 我今天早上错过了你的电话，所以午饭后我会给你回电话。

definitionEn: n. a unit of heat equal to the amount of heat required to raise the temperature of one kilogram of water by one degree at one atmosphere pressure; used by nutritionists to characterize the energy-producing potential in food\nn. unit of heat defined as the quantity of heat required to raise the temperature of 1 gram of water by 1 degree centigrade at atmospheric pressure
definitionZh: n. 卡路里（热量单位）

example.text: Running for thirty minutes can help you burn calories.
example.translationZh: 跑步三十分钟可以帮助你燃烧卡路里。

definitionEn: n. a city in Massachusetts just to the north of Boston; site of Harvard University and the Massachusetts Institute of Technology\nn. a city in eastern England on the River Cam; site of Cambridge University
definitionZh: n. 剑桥

example.text: She studied mathematics at the University of Cambridge.
example.translationZh: 她在剑桥大学学习数学。

definitionEn: n. equipment for taking photographs (usually consisting of a lightproof box with a lens at one end and light-sensitive film at the other)
definitionZh: n. 照相机, 摄影机, 密谈室, 暗箱\n[计] 摄影

example.text: The interview was recorded on camera and broadcast the next day.
example.translationZh: 这次采访被摄像机拍了下来，第二天播出了。

phrase.translationZh: 在镜头前；被摄像机拍下

definitionEn:
n. temporary living quarters specially built by the army for soldiers
n. a group of people living together in a camp
n. temporary lodgings in the country for travelers or vacationers
n. a penal institution (often for forced labor)
definitionZh: n. 露营, 帐篷\nvi. 露营, 扎营\nvt. 使扎营

example.text: The children spent two weeks at a summer camp in the mountains.
example.translationZh: 孩子们在山里的夏令营度过了两周。

definitionEn:
n. a series of actions advancing a principle or tending toward a particular end
n. several related operations aimed at achieving a particular goal (usually within geographical and temporal constraints)
n. an overland journey by hunters (especially in Africa)
v. run, stand, or compete for an office or a position
definitionZh: n. 战役, 运动, 竞选运动\nvi. 参加运动, 作战

example.text: The charity launched a campaign to raise awareness about clean water.
example.translationZh: 这家慈善机构发起了一场运动，以提高人们对清洁水源的认识。

definitionEn: n. a field on which the buildings of a university are situated
definitionZh: n. 校园, 大学生活

example.text: Most first-year students live on campus.
example.translationZh: 大多数一年级学生住在校园里。

definitionZh: a. 加拿大的

example.text: She became a Canadian citizen after living in Toronto for five years.
example.translationZh: 在多伦多生活五年后，她成为了加拿大公民。

definitionEn: n. (astronomy) an indistinct surface feature of Mars once thought to be a system of channels; they are now believed to be an optical illusion\nn. long and narrow strip of water made for boats or for irrigation\nv. provide (a city) with a canal
definitionZh: n. 运河, 水道, 管, 沟渠\nvt. 开运河

example.text: The city's canal system was built centuries ago to transport goods.
example.translationZh: 这座城市的运河系统建于几个世纪前，用于运输货物。

definitionEn:
v. postpone indefinitely or annul something that was scheduled
v. make up for
v. declare null and void; make ineffective
v. make invalid for use
definitionZh:
n. 取消, 撤消, 盖销(邮票)
vt. 取消, 删去, 抵销, 盖销
vi. 相互抵销
[计] 作废

example.text: Heavy rain forced the airline to cancel all flights to the island.
example.translationZh: 大雨迫使航空公司取消了所有飞往该岛的航班。

definitionEn: n. someone who is considered for something (for an office or prize or honor etc.)
definitionZh: n. 候选人, 投考者\n[法] 候选, 候补者

example.translationZh: 她是市场经理职位的有力人选。

definitionEn: n. stick of wax with a wick in the middle\nn. the basic unit of luminous intensity adopted under the Systeme International d'Unites; equal to 1/60 of the luminous intensity per square centimeter of a black body radiating at the temperature of 2,046 degrees Kelvin\nv. examine eggs for freshness by holding them against a light

definitionEn: n stick of wax with a wick in the middle\nn the basic unit of luminous intensity adopted under the Systeme International d'Unites; equal to 1/60 of the luminous intensity per square centimeter of a black body radiating at the temperature of 2,046 degrees Kelvin\nv examine eggs for freshness by holding them against a light
definitionZh: n. 蜡烛, 烛台（candle复数形式）

example.text: She placed two candles on the dinner table and lit them.
example.translationZh: 她在餐桌上放了两根蜡烛并把它们点燃了。

definitionEn:
n. a stick that people can lean on to help them walk
n. a strong slender often flexible stem as of bamboos, reeds, rattans, or sugar cane
n. a stiff switch used to hit students as punishment
v. beat with a cane
definitionZh: n. 手杖, 细长的茎, 藤条\nvt. 以杖击, 以藤编制

example.text: After his knee surgery, my grandfather used a wooden cane to walk around the garden.
example.translationZh: 膝盖手术后，我祖父用一根木手杖在花园里走动。

definitionEn:
n. a large artillery gun that is usually on wheels
n. heavy gun fired from a tank
n. (Middle Ages) a cylindrical piece of armor plate to protect the arm
n. heavy automatic gun fired from an airplane
definitionZh: n. 大炮, 加农炮\nv. 炮轰

example.text: The old fortress still has several cannons on wheels pointing out to sea.
example.translationZh: 那座古老的堡垒里仍架着几门指向大海的装在轮子上的大炮。

definitionEn:
n. a flask for carrying water; used by soldiers or travelers
n. sells food and personal items to personnel at an institution or school or camp etc.

definitionZh: n. 水壶, 军中俱乐部, 临时流动餐馆, 小卖部

example.text: We usually have lunch in the school canteen at noon.
